Datalayer's confirm answers an Operation with "expires_at": null; pi-poppy's parseOperation accepts the member absent but not null, so it reports a failure for an operation the Company performed. The Operations extension doesn't say whether optional members may be null.
Datalayer's cancel answers "result": {"summary", "data": null}; pi-poppy's parseOperation rejects result.data: null. The Operations extension doesn't say whether optional members may be null.

Manzanita's OpenAPI description has templated paths with no parameters declared, so src/poppy sends /api/orders/{order_id}/exchanges literally and gets 404 instead of 403 insufficient_scope; the dpa adapter then reports the 404 as a 200 result.

As with datalayer-ts (undeclared path parameters, so {order_id} is sent literally), and the Python Company checks DPoP htu against the percent-decoded path (scope['path'], not raw_path), so it answers 401 invalid_dpop_proof.
